true.note: Reference / true label column (the rows). Blank = the first categorical column.

predicted.note: Compared / predicted label column (the columns). Blank = the next categorical column.

normalize.note: row = per-true-class recall, the standard confusion reading. The raw count stays in the hover so a 100% row of one observation cannot pass for a hundred.

annotate.note: Print the value in each cell (dropped automatically above 400 cells).

true_order.note: Pin named row labels first; the rest follow in observed order. Never filters.

predicted_order.note: Pin named column labels first; the rest follow in observed order. Never filters.

catalog.name: Selom Confusion Matrix
catalog.summary: Cross-tabulation of two labellings of the same rows — predicted vs true, or (the omics use) a cluster assignment against a reference cell-type annotation, which is how an annotation gets validated. Optional row / column / total normalization, with the raw counts kept reachable. Reports overall agreement and Cohen's kappa only when the two label sets actually match, and names the reason when they do not.
